caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned object that resembles a candlestick or ceremonial cup with a lid. The object is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a metallic appearance, with two small upward-pointing projections at the top that are highlighted with touches of yellow. The form of the object is vertically symmetrical, with a rounded base, a graduated stem of varying thickness, and a cylindrical midsection topped by a slightly domed lid. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige tone, and the composition is enclosed within a rectangular border. The artist's name, "Joseph Wolins," is written in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Lamp
